mintAuthority.summary: USG has three mint routes. At Ethereum block 26096134, the complete authorized market census is 16 markets: the prior 13 plus msETH/OETH, cbBTC/WBTC and reUSD/sDOLA. Thirteen have positive debt shares; authorized markets can remain paused or empty. mintDebt requires isMinter, mintIR requires the sole IRCalculator role and mints to the ControlTower fee treasury, and mintPegKeeper lets the owner mint uncapped USG into either registered peg keeper. USG, ControlTower and MarketCreator share a 3-of-5 Safe (v1.4.1, empty modules, zero guard) with a custom FeeTreasuryFallbackHandler. The owner can authorize arbitrary minters and change role assignments, so the economic authority remains unbounded.

controls.label: USG token role-gated mint functions
controls.capDescription: The token itself imposes no supply cap on any of mintDebt, mintIR or mintPegKeeper; the only gate is the caller's role mapping. Bounds exist per market (user collateral), not in the token.
controls.evidence: Ethereum block 25531083: USG is not a proxy (EIP-1967 implementation slot = 0x0; verified non-proxy source with no upgrade entrypoint). owner() = 0x461B62CB3A7e9Df8f800aE058AE92F855F2c27Ca, controlTower() = 0xF3f7669dcEED2f985815011C19eD68F667267215, totalSupply = 42993004273104510957389060 (~42.99M USG). Verified source: mintDebt requires isMinter[msg.sender], mintIR requires isIRProducer[msg.sender] and mints to controlTower.feeTreasury(), mintPegKeeper is onlyOwner and requires isPegKeeper[pegKeeper]. No amount cap appears in any of the three.

controls.label: Tangent owner Safe (3/5)
controls.capDescription: Can mint uncapped USG to a registered peg keeper via mintPegKeeper (onlyOwner), and can setIsMinter/setIsIRProducer/setIsPegKeeper on any address. No timelock.
controls.evidence: Ethereum block 26096134: threshold 3, five owners, VERSION 1.4.1, no enabled modules, zero guard/moduleGuard. Fallback handler 0x055e53a75598e570ad7970af4cd34e3877817dcf inherits CompatibilityFallbackHandler and forwards feeTreasury() to ControlTower; the Safe and ControlTower returned the same current treasury. Owner getters on USG, ControlTower, MarketCreator and all 16 markets return this Safe. isMinter(Safe) remains false; owner role configuration and uncapped mintPegKeeper remain available.

controls.label: Tangent markets with isMinter (16)
controls.capDescription: Each market mints USG only against user collateral at its configured LTV; the Safe-owned market contracts and MarketCreator set those parameters.
controls.evidence: At block 26096134 all 16 enumerated markets have isMinter and isBurner true. The historical full census of 13 at block 25531083 is extended by three factory events at blocks 25580590, 25646014 and 25731115. Complete delta scans through 26096134 returned no SetIsMinter/SetIsBurner/SetIsIRProducer/SetIsPegKeeper or SetIsMarketCreator changes. The sole current factory remains authorized. Existing mint and borrower-collateral bounds are not relaxed by this census.

controls.label: Tangent MarketCreator (sole market creator)
controls.capDescription: USG.initializeMarket sets isMinter[market] = true for any address a market creator passes, with no event and no cap.
controls.evidence: Ethereum block 25531083: ControlTower.isMarketCreator(0x214c8a10...) = true; the previous MarketCreator 0x51c88d50... was revoked at block 24748515 and had created zero markets. Complete SetIsMarketCreator log history on the ControlTower contains exactly three entries (grant 0x51c88d50 at 24570211, revoke 0x51c88d50 and grant 0x214c8a10 at 24748515). MarketCreator owner() = the 3/5 Tangent Safe at block 26096134.

controls.label: Tangent IRCalculator (sole isIRProducer)
controls.capDescription: mintIR mints accrued interest only, and only to controlTower.feeTreasury() (0x536d4e9C0944dE2aC6657d610Aa99fA5e97Ce493). The rate parameters are owner-set (SetIRParams).
controls.evidence: Ethereum block 25531083: isIRProducer(0xb4e1d3bb...) = true; the complete SetIsIRProducer log history is a single grant at block 24570211 and no revocation. The address is a verified contract named IRCalculator. isIRProducer is false for every other address ever seen in the token's logs.

controls.label: Tangent peg keepers with isPegKeeper (2)
controls.capDescription: Peg keepers cannot mint. They are the only addresses the owner Safe may mint into via mintPegKeeper, and the only addresses burnPegKeeper may burn from.
controls.evidence: Ethereum block 25531083: isPegKeeper(x) = true for 0xf89615f75c8161dc185c03020240905f6b66bad9 (verified contract PegKeeperV2) and 0x8a7f16508d1e8b48bdf36023f378cc04d9506d4e (verified contract Peg_Keeper_V2); the complete SetIsPegKeeper log history is those two grants at block 24570211 and no revocations. isMinter and isIRProducer are false for both.

review.evidence: Current Ethereum block 26096134 confirms the historical role census plus three new factory-created markets (16 total), a 3-of-5 owner Safe and its custom fee-treasury fallback handler. The owner can still authorize arbitrary minters and mint uncapped USG into registered peg keepers. Historical role evidence is retained in individual controls; no favorable economic-cap, reconciliation or supervision change is inferred.
